messages:
sam: Heads-up — PulseAI submitted a request to pin a quantized OZ-13B variant (oz-13q) in ap-southeast-1. They want a stable model id + version for a 3-week pilot. Key asks: regional residency, 50 qps, p99 <200ms. Request link: <https://pulseai.co/req/3287>

maria: Do we know if they're buying Dedicated or just asking hosted region pin? Need SLA/commit details before prioritizing.

sam: Pilot is a paid pilot (3mo). They prefer Hosted with geo-pin (no shared-residency) — basically reserved capacity in APAC. SE said they can commit to capacity spend but want us to guarantee model version stability.

chen: Catalog checklist reminder: we need license text, model artifact manifest, SHA256 hashes for weights, tokenizer, and indication of quant format (eg. 4bit-rtq/qlora/etc). Also confirm any downstream license restrictions. cc @catalog-bot

catalog-bot: created ticket CAT-2897 for ozone-13b -> oz-13q onboarding. Required: license, manifest, weights_sha256, tokenizer_sha256, quant_format, sample_outputs, eval_set. Link: <https://redwood.atlassian.com/CAT-2897>

rachel: Infra note: oz-13q (4-bit) relies on custom kernels we only validated on A100/cuda11.8. APAC pool currently has A100 and T4 nodes. We'll need a quick compatibility test on T4s (if they plan lower-tier hardware) and verify KV cache memory behavior. Possible fallback to fp16 hosted variant if quant fails to meet latency.

maria: Proposed product priority: P1 for intake if license checks out and infra says green. Launch criteria (suggested): 1) perf on 5k validation prompts within p99 target, 2) safety/regression evals pass, 3) automated canary + rollback, 4) cost/unit within agreed pilot budget.

sam: I'll pull license and manifest from Pulse SE today. Also will request their evaluation prompt set. Can we support canary + auto-fallback to eu-west-1 if ap-southeast saturates?

chen: Yes, we'll add a region-fallback policy to the catalog entry. Also adding a required manifest snippet to CAT-2897. Example snippet we need in the upload: ```
model_id: ozone-13b
variant: oz-13q-v1
quant_format: nf4
weights_sha256: <sha256>
config: ozone_config.json
```

rachel: Perf caveat: quantized KV cache increases memory transiently; expect ~+10% memory footprint during generation and possible throughput impact. We'll run a 1k-sample perf job once artifacts are available. Ops: reserve extra buffer in apac pool for that run.

maria: Owners: @chen -> onboarding/cataloG entry, @rachel -> infra validation, @maria -> acceptance & pilot ROI. Adding to product intake board and marking provisional P1.

sam: :thumbsup: I added PulseAI eval set (link in CAT-2897). If we get artifacts by EOD Thu we can run infra validation Mon and schedule canary Wed. Target pilot launch next Friday.

chen: No blockers from catalog side aside from license verification. If license is permissive we'll proceed. Also recommend we pin the exact version id as "oz-13q-v1" in catalog to ensure stability.

maria: Agree. Add rollout rules: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with auto-rollback on perf or safety regression. Also add acceptance tests: 5k prompts perf, 500 safety checks, and cost check below threshold.

sam: OK — I'll coordinate with SE and ops to secure capacity. Anyone object to finalizing "oz-13q-v1" as the pinned version?

chen: No objections. Adding eu-west fallback if apac capacity is insufficient.

rachel: I'll schedule perf runs and post results in CAT-2897.

maria: Thanks — moving to intake board and tagging @ops for capacity reservation.

sam: Thanks team.
